fact: The document is the text of the Uganda Bureau of Statistics Act (Chapter 310), which establishes the Bureau and the national statistical system and commenced on 11 June 1998.

The chairman of the UBOS Board, speaking to the Finance Minister, said UBOS was established under the Uganda Bureau of Statistics Act, 1998 and continues to coordinate the National Statistical System under it (Ministry of Finance report of 7 August 2026).
